messages:
laura: FYI PR #9123 is review-ready but blocked by a flaky CI failure in e2e-payment. We need to land this before the deploy freeze on Thu 2027-07-15. Can someone triage quickly? cc @mike @anya

dev-ci-bot: Build 9123 failed on job `e2e-payment` — test timed out. Log excerpt: `TimeoutError: payment-service did not respond in 30s` — https://ci.redwood/build/9123

mike: I'll kick a rerun now and try to reproduce locally if it fails again.

anya: I can look tomorrow morning PST. Do we have repro steps in the PR?

laura: steps are in the PR description. Quick run: `make test-e2e SERVICE=payment` and then `docker-compose up payment-stub`.

mike: Rerun started — https://ci.redwood/build/9123/rerun/2

dev-ci-bot: Rerun #2 failed again. New failure: 502 from payment-stub with `ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer`

sre-oncall: Heads-up: there's scheduled infra maintenance Wed 02:00–03:00 UTC that could affect test infra. I'll check health of payment-stub and the test network during that window.

chuck: If maintenance hits the test infra, we should avoid merges that depend on those tests during the window. @laura do we have flexibility to slip past the freeze if needed?

jen: Product is hoping this lands in the patch for Thursday. If we can't guarantee stability, PM suggested we might ship without this change and include it in the next release.

anya: Plan: I'll try reproducing with the stub and add a transient-retry in the e2e harness if this is a network flake. ETA: EOD tomorrow. If I can make the test resilient, reruns should pass.

mike: Sounds good. @laura please add an approval ping to the PR once tests are green again. I'll hold a final rerun and merge if approvals + SRE sign-off are present.

laura: Will do — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

dev-ci-bot: Note: merge queue is blocked due to unstable tests. Per policy, use `/merge force` only with explicit approvals and SRE sign-off when infra instability is suspected.
